2.stem_plain: The students stayed back ________ recess to finish some schoolwork.

3.stem_plain: As Matthew ________ the school, it began to rain.

4.stem_plain: "________ is for you," said Mother as she handed Lisa her present.

5.stem_plain: "Too ________ salt in your food is bad for you. Reduce your salt intake," said the doctor to her patient.

6.stem_plain: My teacher(s) ________ happy with me as I help out in class every day.

7.stem_plain: Nelly and Lila ________ proud of themselves when they found out that they did well for their class test.

1.note: 句尾有明确的过去时间状语 “last week”（上周），动作发生在过去并已完成，需用一般过去时，故选 completed。
1.concept: 动词时态 — Verb Tenses — Simple Past Tense
1.zh: 西蒂上周完成了她的项目。

2.note: 表示“在……期间”，这里指在课间休息期间，固定搭配用介词 “during recess”。
2.zh: 学生们在课间休息时留下来完成一些学校作业。

3.note: “As”（当……时）引导的时间状语从句表示一个持续性的背景动作，与主句突然开始下雨（began）相对比，从句需用过去进行时，主语 Matthew 搭配 was leaving。
3.concept: 动词时态 — Verb Tenses — Past Continuous Tense
3.zh: 当马修正在离开学校时，天开始下雨了。

4.note: 根据后文 “as she handed Lisa her present”（当她把礼物递给莉萨时），说明礼物距离很近；且 “present” 是单数名词，代词作主语需用近指单数指示代词 “This”。
4.concept: 指示代词 — Demonstrative Pronouns — this
4.zh: “这是给你的，”母亲把礼物递给莉萨时说道。

5.note: “salt”（盐）是不可数名词，不能用 few 或 many 修饰；结合医生建议的 “Reduce your salt intake”（减少盐的摄入），可知是指食物里盐“太多”，故选 much。
5.concept: 数量词修饰 — Quantifiers — uncountable nouns
5.zh: “食物中过多的盐对你身体不好。减少你的盐摄入量，”医生对她的病人说。

6.note: 由于原卷带有括号印作 “My teacher(s)”，通常依循括号外主要单数形式、或结合考卷在印刷此干扰项时的语法一致性，再根据时间状语 “every day”（每天）可知用一般现在时。此处标准答案设计为单数 is（亦或是复数印刷错误，但时态锁定在现在时区，结合日常小常识，任课教师为单数，故选 is）。
6.concept: 主谓一致与时态 — Subject-Verb Agreement & Tense — Present Tense
6.zh: 我的老师对我挺满意的，因为我每天都在班里帮忙。

7.note: “when” 引导的时间状语从句使用的是过去时（found, did），主句也应使用过去时；主语是 “Nelly and Lila”（复数），因此选 “were”。
7.concept: 主谓一致与时态 — Subject-Verb Agreement & Tense — Past Tense (Plural)
7.zh: 内莉和莱拉发现她们在班级测试中取得好成绩时，为自己感到骄傲。

8.note: 句中有时间副词 “now”（现在），表明司机正在进行的动作，需用现在进行时 “is waiting”。
8.concept: 动词时态 — Verb Tenses — Present Continuous Tense
8.zh: “公交车司机现在正等着你们上车呢，”老师说道。

9.note: 后半句“我丢了以前那一本”是前半句“买了一本新练习本”的原因，因此使用表原因的连词 “because”。
9.zh: 我买了一本新的写作练习本，因为我把以前的那本弄丢了。

10.note: 根据谓语动词 “needs” 为单数形式，以及后文 “Not a single book should be dropped”（一本书都不能掉），可知此处指的是“每一本书”，故选 “Each”。
10.concept: 代词与主谓一致 — Pronouns & SVA — each of
10.zh: “这些书的每一本都需要小心对待。一本书都不能掉，”图书管理员说。

11.stem_plain: The ____________ at the theatre clapped loudly once the performance ended.

15.stem_plain: The football team cheered and shouted ____________ each time their teammate scored a goal.

11.zh: 剧院里的观众在演出结束时大声鼓掌。
11.note: “audience”指剧院、音乐厅或电影院观看表演的“观众”，最符合戏剧表演（performance）的语境。

choices.eg: The audience stood up and cheered at the end of the concert.
A large group of onlookers watched the firefighters work.
The spectators filled the stadium to watch the grand finale.
The innocent bystanders quickly scattered when the fight broke out.

12.zh: 好奇的学生们冲出教室，想找出奇怪的声音是从哪里传来的。
12.note: “curious”意思是“好奇的”，解释了学生们为什么急于找出奇怪声音的源头。

choices.eg: The pilot remained calm and landed the plane safely.
The curious puppy sniffed around the closed wooden box.
The hardworking farmer spent the entire morning tilling the fields.
She looked completely uninterested in the long history lesson.

13.zh: 妈妈看到我在寒冷中发抖，提醒我穿上夹克。
13.note: “shivering”意思是“（因寒冷或害怕而）发抖、打寒颤”，完全对应身体在寒冷（in the cold）中的自然反应。

choices.eg: The tall trees were swaying gently in the evening breeze.
The toddler was wobbling a little as he took his first steps.
The wet dog was shivering after being caught in the heavy rain.
His voice was wavering as he tried to speak about the incident.

14.zh: 当金赢得金牌时，整个全场的人都高兴地欢呼起来。
14.note: “delight”意思是“高兴、欣喜”，与赢得金牌（won the gold medal）带来的狂喜以及人群的欢呼完全吻合。

choices.eg: To our great delight, our school team won the championship match.
The retired old man spent his leisure time gardening and reading.
The detective looked at the messy office with a hint of suspicion.
The sudden crash of thunder caused a great commotion in the crowded wet market.

15.zh: 每当队友进球时，足球队都会热情高涨地欢呼和呐喊。
15.note: “enthusiastically”意思是“热情地、热烈地”，修饰欢呼和呐喊的动作，符合队友进球时的激动氛围。

choices.eg: The dark clouds gradually disappeared as the sun came out.
He stood awkwardly in the corner of the room, not knowing anyone.
She reluctantly agreed to lend her favorite toy to her cousin.
The fans cheered enthusiastically when the singer walked onto the stage.

16.zh: 西蒙向燃烧的炉子泼了一桶水来灭火。
16.note: “put out”是固定短语，意思是“扑灭（火、香烟等）”。

choices.eg: She put in a lot of effort to complete her science project.
Please remember to put on your shoes before leaving the house.
The sports day was put off until next week due to the thunderstorm.
The brave firemen worked throughout the night to put out the forest fire.

17.note: 修饰名词短语 dribbling skills，指代 Jim（单数男性）的运球技巧，意为‘他的’，故选 his。

18.note: 作并列句的主语，指代前文被踢的‘球（the ball）’，单数中性代词用 it，故选 it。

19.note: 作句子主语，后面有 stared at each other（互相盯着看），说明是指代 Jim 和他的姐姐‘他们’两个人，故选 they。

20.note: 作句子主语，指代前文的时间状语从句中的‘妈妈（their mother）’，且后文有 she pointed，确定为女性单数主格，故选 she。

cloze: Jim loved to boast that he had good football skills. One day, his sister asked him to show off [Q17] dribbling skills in the living room. He kicked the ball too hard and [Q18] flew through the air, hitting a potted plant. Soil scattered everywhere.
Alarmed, [Q19] stared at each other. When their mother saw the mess, [Q20] frowned. Then, she pointed at a broom.
zh: 吉姆喜欢吹嘘自己有很好的足球技术。一天，他的姐姐让他客厅里展示他的运球技巧。他踢球踢得太用力了，球在空中飞过，撞到了一个盆栽植物。泥土撒得满地都是。
受到惊吓后，他们互相盯着看。当他们的妈妈看到这乱七八糟的景象时，她皱起了眉头。然后，她指向了一把扫帚。

cloze: Prototype comprehension cloze: The sun lend me a [Q46(hend)] when I am down.

46.note: 完美契合经典口语及书面语习语 lend a hand，表示在需要时“伸出援手”或“搭把手”提供帮助。

29.stem_plain: The famous author came to our school. She was tall.

30.stem_plain: Don was late for school. He took his time to get ready.

29.concept: 定语从句 — Relative Clause (Subject Pronoun 'who')
29.zh: 来到我们学校的那位著名作家身材高大。
29.note: who 引导的定语从句修饰先行词 The famous author。从句必须紧跟在所修饰的主语后，然后再接主句的剩余部分（或反之：The famous author, who was tall, came to our school. 但更自然的紧凑合并是将从句置于主语后）。
29.answer: The famous author who came to our school was tall.

30.concept: 让步状语从句 — Concessive Clause ('Although')
30.zh: 虽然唐上学迟到了，但他还是慢慢悠悠地做准备。
30.note: although 引导让步状语从句，意为“虽然”。注意英语中 although 不能与 but 同时出现在一个句子中，且从句与主句之间用逗号隔开。
30.answer: Although Don was late for school, he took his time to get ready.

38.stem_plain: Why was Ben excited when he entered the classroom? [2m]

39.stem_plain: How can you tell that Zaki felt uneasy when he first met Ben? [1m]

40.stem_plain: For questions 40 to 41, read each statement and tick ✓ "True" or "False". The first example has been done for you. [2m]

rows: 40. Zaki did not buy food from the canteen during lunch.
41. Zaki had a bag that could hold his books securely.

42.stem_plain: In paragraph 5, Zaki teared as he was feeling _______. [1m]

43.cue: That night, he [A(rummaged)], through his cupboard and [B(located)] a brand-new bag he had forgotten about.

44.stem_plain: In paragraph 9, what did Zaki's classmates do to show kindness to him? [2m]

38.note: 对应原文第1-2行：'Ben ran into his classroom with his new bag... He was keen to show off the bag to his friends.' 因为他带着新书包，并且非常渴望向朋友们炫耀它。
38.answer: He was keen to show off his new bag to his friends.

39.note: 对应原文第3-4行以及第5-6行：扎基当时‘低着头’、‘紧紧抓着一个破旧的书包’、并且‘默默地盯着地板’。答出这些身体语言的表现即可。
39.answer: He kept his eyes down, held his worn-out bag tightly and stared at the floor silently when Ben greeted him.

40.note: 对应原文第7行：'Ben spotted Zaki eating a plain bun he had brought from home'，他吃的是从家里带的白面包，不是在食堂买的。因此该表述为 True。

41.note: 对应原文第9行：'Zaki's bag was torn and had many holes in it. It looked like his books could fall out at any moment.' 他的书包破了全是洞，书随时都会掉出来，所以无法安全地装书。因此该表述为 False。

42.note: 对应原文第五自然段（第12-15行）：扎基独自坐在食堂，悄悄擦掉眼泪，是因为他由于自身艰难的处境感到难过和沮丧，故选 (1) upset。

43.note: 寻找与 'searched'（搜寻、翻找）同义的词。(A) rummaged 是翻找、搜寻的意思，符合题意；(B) located 是定位、找到的意思。

44.note: 对应原文第22-23行（即对应故事尾部倒数第二段）：'This act of kindness encouraged other students to share their school supplies and play with Zaki during recess.' 他的同学向他分享了学习用品，并在课间休息时和他一起玩耍。
44.answer: They shared their school supplies with him and played with him during recess.

45.note: 对应原文最后一段（第24行）：'Ben smiled. His heart was full.' 他的内心感到无比充实，说明他对自己的行为带来的结果感到非常 'satisfied'（满意/欣慰）。

lines.3: seat, he saw a new student next to him — quiet, eyes down, hands holding a worn-out
lines.5: His name was Zaki. Ben greeted him, expecting a reply. Yet, Zaki stared at the
lines.6: floor silently, leaving Ben feeling uncomfortable. However, Ben kept a straight face.
lines.7: During lunch break, Ben spotted Zaki eating a plain bun he had brought from
lines.8: home, all alone. Around him, others were having hot meals from different stalls. Zaki's
lines.9: bag was torn and had many holes in it. It looked like his books could fall out at any
lines.11: Worried, Ben decided to keep an eye on Zaki.
lines.12: A week passed. Ben noticed that during every lunch break, Zaki would sit alone
lines.13: in the canteen, staring blankly at his bun before taking small bites. He would also wipe
lines.14: away his tears when he thought no one was watching. Ben wondered how he could

lines.17: he had forgotten about. He put a note in it that read:

paragraphs.1: 那是开学的第一天。本背着他的新书包跑进教室，书包在身旁一拍一拍的。他非常渴望向朋友们炫耀他的新书包。回到座位上时，他看到身边坐着一个新同学——很安静，低着头，双手紧紧地抓着一个破旧的书包。
paragraphs.5: 他的名字叫扎基。本向他打了个招呼，并期待着他的回应。然而，扎基只是默默地盯着地板，这让本感到有些尴尬。不过，本脸上并没有表现出来，依然保持着平静的神色。
paragraphs.7: 午休时间，本注意到扎基正独自一人吃着从家里带出来的白面包。在他的周围，其他同学都在不同的档口吃着热腾腾的饭菜。扎基的书包已经破了，上面有很多洞。看起来他的书随时都有可能掉出来。
paragraphs.11: 由于有些担心，本决定暗中留意扎基。
paragraphs.12: 一个星期过去了。本发现每次午休时，扎基都会独自一人坐在食堂里，两眼无神地盯着面包，然后才一小口一小口地咬着。当他以为没人看他时，他还会悄悄擦掉眼泪。本心里琢磨着自己该怎么去帮助他。
paragraphs.16: 那天晚上，他在自己的橱柜里翻找了一番，翻出了一个已经被他遗忘的全新书包。他在里面放了一张小纸条，上面写着：
paragraphs.19: 第二天早上，他把书包放在了扎基的椅子上。当扎基来到座位时，他惊呆了。他打开书包读完纸条后，惊讶得瞪大了眼睛，简直不敢相信。他缓缓转过头看着本。眼里含着泪水，向本道了谢。
paragraphs.22: 这个善良的举动也感染了其他同学，大家开始主动分享自己的学校用品，并在课间休息时和扎基一起玩耍。
paragraphs.24: 本笑了。他的内心感到无比充实。他已经为扎基种下了善良的种子。
